title: If Li Longji's Life Were a Stock: LONGJI
angle: Political authority and the outcomes of imperial governance, not private happiness or human worth
note: LONGJI is a conceptual index of political power and governance, not a real stock price or a measure of human worth. Zero marks the end of life.

events.title: Born in Luoyang
events.summary: Born to Li Dan, the future Emperor Ruizong.

events.title: Tanglong coup
events.summary: Helped overthrow Empress Wei's faction; became crown prince.

events.title: Takes the throne
events.summary: Ruizong abdicated; Li Longji became emperor.

events.title: Secures power
events.summary: Defeated Princess Taiping's faction and appointed Yao Chong.

events.title: Appoints Song Jing
events.summary: Song Jing became chancellor as early Kaiyuan reforms continued.

events.title: Kaiyuan high point
events.summary: Zhang Jiuling led the court as governance reached a peak.

events.title: Zhang dismissed
events.summary: Zhang Jiuling left the center of power; Li Linfu rose.

events.title: Tianbao era begins
events.summary: The era name changed amid prosperity and growing risks.

events.title: An Lushan gains power
events.summary: An Lushan took command at Fanyang as frontier power grew.

events.title: Yang becomes consort
events.summary: Yang was made a noble consort; private life alone does not explain the crisis.

events.title: Nanzhao defeat
events.summary: Tang forces suffered a major defeat in the southwest.

events.title: Yang Guozhong rises
events.summary: After Li Linfu's death, Yang Guozhong became right chancellor.

events.title: Warning dismissed
events.summary: Xuanzong did not act on a warning about An Lushan.

events.title: An Lushan Rebellion
events.summary: An Lushan rebelled, plunging the empire into prolonged war.

events.title: Flight and abdication
events.summary: Fled the capital; the Mawei incident followed, and Suzong took the throne.

events.title: Returns to Chang'an
events.summary: Returned after the capitals were retaken, without governing power.

events.title: Moved to the west palace
events.summary: His movement and influence were further restricted.

events.title: Death; LONGJI halted
events.summary: He died at about 76; his historical impact continued.

sources.title: Metropolitan Museum of Art: Tang Dynasty
